purpose: Stage9 design and smoke only; formal runs require stage10 authorization

environment.hostLimitation: Same Windows/Docker host and shared storage; ActiveProcessorCount is not an OS CPU quota. Record all background processes, total CPU and memory. Local and AWS runs must never be pooled.

dataset.additionalData: Frozen stage8 clone; actual total counts and hashes recorded separately
dataset.actorSelection: (iteration*17+floor(iteration/activeUsers))%activeUsers; 1000 active normally, 900 Community + 100 disjoint repair actors in mixed tests
dataset.reset: Restore immutable private snapshot into new stage9 databases; preserve old databases and uploads. Reset before EVERY independent run, including API/page and warmup.
dataset.quota: Original posting limits preserved. Historical fixture timestamps are January 2026. Quota errors remain errors, never discounted; do not reset guards during a measured run.

units.primary: successful business iterations / elapsed wall seconds including drain
units.secondary: completed iterations/s and explicit instrumented HTTP calls/s
units.note: Each explicit client call and auto-followed redirect GET counted. Endpoint latency is whole call including its redirect/body; business latency includes form/token/write/readback. Counts are not browser subresource loads.

mix.mapping: bucket=(iteration*37)%100, exact mix per consecutive 100 iterations. Smoke is too short to establish business proportions.

classification: invalid content including missing write readback

sustainedCapacity.rule: Report highest offered rate meeting every goal in all three repeats; a failed level is a valid observation. Never assume higher rates pass, never silently change targets.

mixed.rule: Run independent open-arrival repair and community streams concurrently; compare repair p95 to repair-only baseline.

smoke.purpose: Validate scripts, auth, content, counters, restore and metrics only; not a capacity result

missingMetricsRule: NOT_RUN/FAIL readiness; never replace unavailable values with zero or claim capacity without required observations
